purpose: Paired contract witnesses for protocol/local-setup-token-hosted-qualification-proposal.md; not a wire format or executed runtime results.
baseline: Every positive control assumes separately adopted and behaviorally qualified account/path, source/API, hosted carrier, final-owner and lifecycle contracts. Without them every hosted node start remains unavailable under revision 1.

cases.positive_control: The station UID and host match its independently enrolled protected source and binding, with the admitted profile lock.
cases.negative_neighbor: Keep the same profile lock, host and requested source projection, but execute under a different UID.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The positive control may reach the qualified final boundary; the wrong UID refuses credential_binding_mismatch before material delivery or child start.
cases.preservation: Neither account's source, HOME, login or profile is copied, adopted or repaired.
cases.limit: Lock equality proves neither account authority nor runtime no-read behavior. Existing metadata wrong-UID checks cover only their local binding projection.

cases.positive_control: The selected role profile's source, pinned revision, dependency closure and lock match the separately admitted destination configuration.
cases.negative_neighbor: One dependency or lock changes without a reviewed pin/closure change while the station label remains the same.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The positive control retains the admitted closure; drift refuses before start without silent repair or repinning. The owning carrier must publish the exact diagnostic before implementation.
cases.preservation: The original closure, lock, HOME and source selection remain unchanged.
cases.limit: This witness allocates no new refusal code and does not require account-dependent rendered paths to be byte-identical.

cases.positive_control: The destination has an owner-published supported cache, managed HOME and root layout with its required access and private Git administration boundaries.
cases.negative_neighbor: Keep valid source metadata but require an unsupported writable shared cache, inaccessible root, operator Git back-link or old operator HOME.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The positive control reaches the qualified preparation boundary; each unsupported layout refuses before start under its owning contract without a fallback layout.
cases.preservation: No access broadening, account creation, root copying or modification of either existing HOME/cache is used to make the negative pass.
cases.limit: A metadata or schema pass does not prove destination filesystem isolation or access.

cases.positive_control: A separately provisioned station account has independently admitted source authority and explained account-dependent context/rendered-path differences.
cases.negative_neighbor: Copy the same root and lock under an operator UID or reuse the operator HOME, then present matching root hashes as isolation evidence.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The positive control can supply account-bound qualification evidence; the copied-root control cannot qualify an isolated station or authorize a hosted start.
cases.preservation: Existing accounts, roots, homes and trust bindings are preserved; no real continuity rows enter the public corpus.
cases.limit: An unexplained different hash is also insufficient. Isolation requires the owning account/path contracts and observed behavior.

cases.positive_control: The per-session final owner under the station UID independently resolves the exact requested source projection and validates protected binding, policy and invocation.
cases.negative_neighbor: Replace or re-enroll the source after preparation while replaying its old reference or generation in the hosted request.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The valid control starts one approved process through AuthorizeAndStart; drift refuses credential_source_stale with no native or per-home fallback.
cases.preservation: No material enters the carrier, daemon, restart recipe, receipt or generic environment map; no forbidden partial preparation writes remain.
cases.limit: A matching requested projection is not authority. The shared daemon never retrieves, retains or distributes material.

cases.positive_control: A qualified final owner adds the selected token only to one approved Claude child's private environment; other admitted process inputs remain exact.
cases.negative_neighbor: Supply a competing auth name with an empty or equal value, alter an endpoint/executable, or route delivery through a daemon callback, token getter or wrapper.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The valid control observes one final injection. Competing inputs refuse credential_source_conflict; binding mismatches refuse credential_binding_mismatch; unqualified routes refuse credential_injection_unavailable, according to revision 1 admission order.
cases.preservation: Refusal starts no child and leaves source and HOME unchanged; permitted lifecycle refusal telemetry carries no material or material digest.
cases.limit: Synthetic exec observes only its instrumented boundary, not actual Claude OAuth or harness containment.

cases.positive_control: The lifecycle owner proves the old generation quiescent and released, then authorizes one target operation under the current generation.
cases.negative_neighbor: Lose the start acknowledgement, retain uncertain execution, or race two target-generation start requests; infer absence from a missing PID, quiet inbox or expired TTL.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The positive control starts one target. Unknown execution retains claims and reconciles the same operation/manager/generation; concurrent requests cannot start a duplicate or steal the lease.
cases.preservation: Old sessions, homes, locks, generation records and recovery claims remain intact until their authoritative transition.
cases.limit: Node material-release locking alone does not prove lifecycle one-start ordering; both boundaries require evidence.

cases.positive_control: A separately authorized fresh source and current lifecycle generation enter the qualified boundary after recovery; expiry is checked when known.
cases.negative_neighbor: Complete local revoke before material release, restore an old filesystem snapshot, and replay the old source authorization or released execution generation.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The positive control can start with fresh authority. Completed revoke refuses credential_source_revoked; replaced generation/reference refuses credential_source_stale in the applicable source state. Rollback cannot revive revoked authority or a released execution generation.
cases.preservation: Recovery preserves revoked/missing/unreadable/stale distinctions, recovery records and unknown claims; it does not recreate old credentials or delete a HOME.
cases.limit: Local revoke does not recall a token already delivered, revoke it at the vendor, or prove process death. Unknown expiry remains unknown.

cases.positive_control: A separately authorized pinned real harness confines disposable sentinel delivery across child probes, MCP interpolation/settings reload, hooks, tools, plugin helpers, telemetry and debug/transcript sinks.
cases.negative_neighbor: Enable a known-leaking disposable control at an observed sink; compare it with the same unmodified harness/configuration control.
cases.expected_when_implemented: The known leak fails its detector for the intended sink, and the clean control passes all required sinks before claiming containment for that exact tuple.
cases.preservation: No real operator credential or destructive live-session operation is used; persisted evidence is sanitized and carries no material or material digest.
cases.limit: Mock exec, guessed scrub flags, clean initial environment and a detector that never sees its planted leak cannot qualify the real harness.

cases.positive_control: Evidence separately identifies the exact reviewed source/API/carrier, account/path, lifecycle, platform, real harness, configuration and mode tuple with owner-run actual OAuth authentication.
cases.negative_neighbor: Promote a JSON/schema pass, synthetic executor, present readiness row or headless result into actual OAuth, PTY/attach/resume or live pilot qualification.
cases.expected_when_implemented: Only the explicitly qualified tuple may advertise credential-injection/1; every unsupported hosted or Terminal mode remains credential_injection_unavailable before start.
cases.preservation: Failed or unknown prerequisites preserve the existing route refusals and live sessions; no native fallback or provider launch occurs to fill an evidence gap.
cases.limit: The owning Curator pilot precedes separately admitted later-host activation. This document itself executes none of these gates.
